H1_Role: Hierarchical model with explicit regional climate interactions
H1_Temperature_Coverage: Region-specific linear December-temperature slopes through region interactions
H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Region-specific quadratic or piecewise deficit/wet terms, depending on selected candidate
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Explicit North versus Center/South temperature and soil-moisture contrasts
Temporal_Predictor_Coverage: Centered harvest-year trend included in every candidate; optional AR(1) residual structure
Governorate_Structure: Governorate random intercept; candidate random year or soil-moisture slopes; selected candidate may include AR(1) residual correlation
Specification_Warnings: The model is selected through rolling-origin validation on 2000-2012. Its 2013-2018 predictions are conditional on observed test-period predictors. Forecasting-model summaries are not a substitute for the separate full-period H1 inference procedure.

H1_Role: Median conditional-quantile model with explicit regional climate interactions
H1_Temperature_Coverage: Region-specific December-temperature slopes through temp_dec_c and temp_cs
H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Region-specific quadratic soil-moisture slopes or regional deficit/wet terms, depending on selected candidate
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Explicit North versus Center/South temperature and soil-moisture contrasts
Temporal_Predictor_Coverage: Centered harvest-year trend included in every candidate
Specification_Warnings: The primary prediction is the raw median quantile (tau = 0.50); rearranged quantiles are supplementary. Forecasting-model summaries are not a substitute for the separate full-period H1 inference procedure.

H1_Role: Nonlinear model with region-specific climate smooths
H1_Temperature_Coverage: Region-specific smooths s(temp_dec_c, by = region) in every candidate formula
H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Region-specific smooths s(sm_z, by = region) in every candidate formula
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Region-specific temperature and soil-moisture smooths; regional vegetation smooths depend on selected candidate
Temporal_Predictor_Coverage: Harvest-year smooth or linear trend included in every candidate
Specification_Warnings: The selected GAM is chosen through rolling-origin validation on 2000-2012. Smooth-term summaries from the forecasting fit are not a substitute for the separate full-period H1 inference procedure.
